source.prefix_resolved_by: holdings_performance.resolved_prefix(blackdiamond_z09, positions_prefix, firm_scope) -> 45 characters, same as the gold script
source.anchor: schwab/08335338/silver/dim_position/date=YYYY-MM-DD/ (closing_price by cusip; the Schwab own-date close)
source.price: Market Value / Units, rows with Units > 0 and Market Value > 0 and a CUSIP
source.account_key: AccountID, replaced at read time by a one-way digest; used only to group rows, never written

rule: PRD ADDENDUM v0.35, ordered, the first that applies: (1) UNGRADEABLE: one or more priced securities the instrument cannot place at a close, whatever the other rows read, with the list of every kind present from ANCHOR_NOT_LANDED, OUTSIDE_ANCHOR, NO_CUSIP, NEITHER_CLOSE, NEGATIVE_POSITION; (2) ACCT_PRIOR_DATE; (3) ACCT_OWN_DATE; (4) NOTHING_TO_GRADE.  Row kinds as IB-pr-429's row_types: OUTSIDE_ANCHOR = outside_anchor, NO_CUSIP = no_cusip, NEITHER_CLOSE = a moved priced row at neither close, NEGATIVE_POSITION = negative_position; ANCHOR_NOT_LANDED = the anchor's close for the day or the prior trading day is absent from the anchor at read time.

ungradeable_kinds.anchor_not_landed_note: the days of the 85 whose own or prior-day anchor partition is absent from the anchor at read time; the days are listed by count only

anchor_landing_order.note: from object LastModified (list_objects_v2), latest object per partition, this run; counts only.  A later rewrite of an old day shows the rewrite time.  Not turned into claims.

cash_flagged_priced_outside_anchor.treatment: primary: as IB-pr-429, a cash-flagged priced row outside the anchor is cash (nothing to grade), not OUTSIDE_ANCHOR.  The addendum does not say; the CTO rules it.
cash_flagged_priced_outside_anchor.would_move_note: account-days holding such a row whose claim is not already UNGRADEABLE; they would change claim to UNGRADEABLE

first_day_treatment.treatment: As IB-pr-429: the prior partition of the first graded day (2026-06-09) is ungraded, so no claim exists for it.  The account-days of 2026-06-10 are claimed and counted in account_days, but are NOT eligible and are outside the serving counts.  Eligible account-days are those present today and on the prior GRADED day.

serving_rule.blank_reason_order: today_UNGRADEABLE, today_ACCT_PRIOR_DATE, yesterday_UNGRADEABLE, yesterday_ACCT_PRIOR_DATE (the first that applies)
serving_rule.good_claims: ACCT_OWN_DATE or NOTHING_TO_GRADE, today and the prior trading day

v0_34_rule_same_pass.note: IB-pr-429's alternative (good = OWN_DATE or nothing_to_grade), run on the same rows; the v0.34 floor was 25.0 percent of 75,796 and 169 of 999

sixth_reason_rows.description: non-cash rows with a non-zero Market Value that the instrument does not price (Units null, zero or of the opposite sign to Market Value) and that are neither a NO_CUSIP row (Units > 0, Market Value > 0, no CUSIP) nor a NEGATIVE_POSITION row (both negative).  Such a row has no price, so rule 4 reads it as 'rows with no price'; it is counted here, not fitted to one of the five kinds and not made a kind.
sixth_reason_rows.treatment_in_the_counts: the row adds no kind and moves no claim: its account-day reads by its other rows (see account_days_by_new_claim)

control.fixture: 4 trading days, six accounts, 2 moving securities and one that does not move.  A own every day.  B is at the prior close on D2.  C: cash only D1, cash + an unmoved security D2, a moved row at neither close D3, a priced security outside the anchor D4.  E: a valued row with no CUSIP D1, a negative position D2, a row with null Units and Market Value D3 and D4.  F (new): D1 own rows + a priced security outside the anchor; D2 an own row + a valued row with no CUSIP + a negative position (two kinds in one account-day); D3 a prior-close row + a priced security outside the anchor; D4 an own row.  H (new): own rows every day and, on D1, a cash-flagged priced row outside the anchor.  One separate call: a day whose anchor is not in hand.
